header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: To bring a thing into place ready for use, and the weight so brought. What is carried, and the act of taking it up.
That which brings a thing into place ready for use. It carries in and does not act.
Belonging to here — on this machine, in this scope, sovereign to its own place before any network.
Fitting a thing to a particular place and tongue. Localization is the work of not requiring a user to travel to be understood.
Fitted to a particular place and tongue. Localisation is the work of not requiring a user to travel to be understood.
To hold closed against opening. A lock assumes a key exists and is held by someone.

The stone that points: any text or URL encoded to a QR matrix and drawn as SVG, entirely on the machine — Reed-Solomon error correction, mask selection and version fitting all computed here, so a code can be made with no network, no service, and no package fetched at run time. Custom by construction: the module shape, the quiet zone, the two colours and an optional centre reservation are the caller's, and the encoder refuses any appearance that would cost more error correction than the code carries. Born of a first-user need named twice — the app-link screen in THE-CARRY, and sharing test builds with testers by hand.
A running record kept as things happen. Its worth is that it was written at the time and not reconstructed after.
The running record kept as it happens — entries in order, stamped and honest; the spring's own provenance water.
That which writes down what happened as it happens. A logger's value is that it records without being asked each time.
The act of establishing who you are to a system. The threshold between anonymous and known.
A mark standing for a maker or a work. Recognition compressed into one shape.

The lock the clavis's key fits in: a credential verified against an artefact's own bytes, and a door that names which public keys may open it. A GATE, NEVER A CIPHER — nothing is encrypted and nothing is decrypted, and the declared host surface carries only verify and digest so that it cannot be. Every no is a told no, named in a small fixed set — digest mismatch (the bytes are not the bytes it was claimed over, checked before the signature because it is the more useful sentence) · signature invalid (a foreign key, a re-labelled author, a moved moment and a forgery all answer here, deliberately, because naming which would tell a forger how close they got) · malformed (asked before anything reaches a host, so a host is never fed rubbish) · and, on a fitted door only, key not admitted. A host that throws is a shut door, because a lock that fails open is not a lock. A lok holds keys and nothing else: no identities, no roles, no expiry, no clock, and no revocation register — which it says out loud at every locking rather than implying. Lok, Sanskrit loka: world, realm of existence, space — from the root lok, to see, view, perceive (KP, 2026-09-02).
To turn attention through the eyes — seeing on purpose; and the appearance a thing offers back.
How a thing appears to the eye. Appearance is real evidence and never the whole of what a thing is.
The finding of a value by its key. Retrieval where the address is already known.
The frame that holds threads still so they can be crossed into cloth. A loom makes weaving possible by holding tension.
A path returning to its start, run again. A loop repeats and does not necessarily progress.
What a group knows and passes on without writing down. Lore is held by the community rather than by any record.
Least of those present. Lowest is a fact about a set, and changes when the set does.
The timed-lyrics file format, spoken lowercase — words married to their moments so a song can be read along.
How much light a thing gives or reflects. Luminosity is what decides legibility before colour does.
Words written to be sung. Lyric is the oldest place where a body's feeling was allowed a form.
At the large scale. Also a shorthand that expands into more — both are about one thing standing for much.
An effect whose working is hidden from the one who sees it. In systems, magic is where behaviour cannot be traced — a warning, not a compliment.
The principal one among several. Naming something main makes everything else secondary by implication.
One who keeps a thing working after the making is done. Maintenance is the unglamorous reason anything lasts.
The work of keeping a thing as it should be. Maintenance produces nothing new and is the reason anything lasts.
Greater in importance or extent. Major is a ranking and always implies a minor.
To bring about by hand or craft — the plainest verb of creation.
To hold responsibility for how a thing runs. Management is coordination, not ownership.
The work of keeping a thing running well over time. Management is maintenance applied to people and process.
One who holds responsibility for how a thing is run. Management is coordination, not ownership.
A declared list of what is included. A manifest is a claim about contents, checkable against them.
The showing forth of what was hidden or intended. A manifestation is the visible end of something already real.
That which brings the intended into visible form. Manifestation is the showing forth of something already real.
Done by hand rather than automatically. Also the book that says how. Both put the doing back with a person.
A work as written before it is published. Literally hand-written — the form a thing takes while still the author's.
A drawn correspondence between a territory and a surface small enough to hold. Named for the cloth it was drawn on, not for the land.
That which establishes a correspondence between two sets. It carries nothing across but the relation.
A correspondence made explicit — each thing of one kind pointed at its counterpart in another. A mapping is a noun in its own right: the finished bridge, not the act of building it.
Established correspondences between two sets. A mapping carries nothing across but the relation itself.
The space kept outside a thing's edge. Room left deliberately unused, so the thing is not crowded.
A made sign left on a surface. The oldest form of record, and the root beneath both writing and counting.
A plain way of marking text so its structure is readable by both people and machines. A named format rather than a concept.
A sign placed to say this spot matters. A marker holds a position rather than a meaning.

Martyria (Greek μαρτυρία: testimony, the statement of a witness). What a maker's own tool did to a picture, written into the picture, in bytes nothing quietly rounded on the way out. A testimony is bounded by what the witness actually knows, and the whole discipline of this word is the boundary: an application knows exactly one thing, which is what IT did, and the sentence everyone reaches for first — "this image is not AI-generated" — is a claim about someone else's file the moment the picture came in from somewhere else. One overclaim costs the entire declaration its worth to the one person who ever checks it, so every sentence is scoped to this application's own edits, the disclaimer saying so has no off switch and no key that could drop it, and the one origin that may honestly be named — IPTC digitalCapture, for a frame this app's own camera made — is set from a single exact value and from nothing else. algorithmicMedia is deliberately never used, because it covers any algorithm at all and would mislead every reader who has learned it means a model; trainedAlgorithmicMedia, the AI term, appears only inside the negation. The claim is columns rather than prose — five key/value pairs a reader showing only one field still learns something true from — and it is carried as PNG iTXt and never tEXt, because tEXt is Latin-1 and would mangle a name with a fada in it. Beneath the sentence lies the reason the bytes can be testified to at all: a two-dimensional canvas backing store holds premultiplied colour, so straight-alpha pixels pushed through it come back quantised — at alpha eight of 255, nine of 256 values a channel survive — and so the file is built by hand, colour type 6, eight bits, all five row filters chosen by cost, with a stored-block fallback so the result is always a valid file. Bytes that are not a picture come back unchanged rather than thrown, because metadata is never worth losing a file over. It answers the flagging problem by giving a checker something honest to read; it is evidence and never a lock, and a chunk anyone can strip is not a claim about tamper.
Presenting a self that is not one's own in order to be accepted. Masking is a skill demanded, then pathologised, and it exhausts the one who does it.
Building by fitting solid pieces together without a regular grid. A layout where each block finds its own place.
How much matter a thing holds. Mass is what resists being moved, which is why it reads as weight.
The authoritative original others are copied from. Also one who has full command of a craft.
To find one thing that answers to another. A match asserts sameness on some axis and ignores the rest.
That which finds where one thing answers to another. It asserts sameness on a chosen axis and ignores the rest.
What a thing is made from — substance before shape.
A grid of values addressed by row and column. Its older sense is womb — the ground something forms within.
The greatest value a thing may take. A ceiling stated in advance.
A compound fragment meaning the highest index. Not an English word; flagged for the mis-cut band.
Permission's own verb — what is allowed, held apart from what must; and the fifth month, spring in full.
Possibly, and possibly not. An honest word that holds a question open rather than closing it early.
Megabyte — a unit of stored size. A named unit rather than a concept.
The extension marking a markdown file. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
The one speaking, as the object of an action. The word by which a being appears in its own account.
What a thing amounts to for whoever meets it. Meaning is made in the meeting — it is not a property held alone.
Short form of medium, and of medical. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
The carriers meaning travels in — image, sound, text, moving picture. The medium is never neutral about what it carries.
Comes together with, or satisfies a standard. Both are about reaching something.
One who belongs to a body, with the standing that belonging carries. Membership is a relationship, not a property.
The belongings-to, spoken plural — the lattice's own word for a concept standing inside a scheme.
What is held from before, and the faculty of holding it. Memory is reconstruction rather than storage, which is why it can be both true and altered.
The accompanying of another as they learn. A mentor goes alongside rather than ahead.
A shown list of what may be chosen. A menu is a statement of the possible as much as an offer.
One who trades — the Bazaar's counterpart to the artisan: the hands that carry goods between makers and seekers under the dignity grammar's laws.
To bring two things together until they are one and the seam is gone. Merging costs the separateness.
Brought together into one, and the join kept — histories or rooms combined without losing either line.

Merismos (Greek μερισμός: apportionment, a dividing into parts). The splits, as data: a Merismos is columns — parts, roles, basis points, and each part's own yes with the moment it was given — dividing the artist's share and nothing else. Points are basis points and must sum to exactly 10000, so a role too small to be a percent is still an integer that cannot round to zero. Opt-in always, in KP's own words "no force or deceptive theft": a part without consent is NAMED in every report and no path consents on anyone's behalf. A description of shares, never a promise of money — nothing in it moves a cent, holds a balance or names a payout. It divides an amount a consumer declares by the largest-remainder method, so integer cents sum to the amount exactly and deterministically; a split that does not close is told in plain words and left exactly as declared. Standalone by law: zero imports, no DOM, no disk, no clock, and nothing throws.
Something sent from one to another to be received. A message has a sender, and that is what separates it from noise.
One who carries what another said. A messenger's discipline is to deliver rather than to improve.
Data about data. What lets a thing be found, dated, credited and trusted, without being the thing itself.
Bonded in a lattice — many holding meaning in common, shared freely across the whole, owned by none.
A repeatable way of doing a thing. A method survives the person who used it, which is what separates it from a knack.
The reasoned way of working — method examined and owned, so the how carries its why.
A chosen measure standing in for something harder to measure. A metric is always a proxy, and forgetting that is how it starts to lie.
Short form of microphone — what turns a voice into something that can be carried. A named instrument rather than a concept.
At the small scale. Of what must be looked at closely to be seen at all.
In the middle. Names a position between two named ends.
The part equally far from both ends. A middle is defined entirely by the ends it lies between.
What sits between two parts and shapes what passes. Middleware is invisible and decides a great deal.
The craft of attending a birth — helping what is arriving to arrive well. The midwife does not make the thing; they make its coming survivable.
To move from one ground to another and settle there. Migration carries what it can and leaves what it cannot.
A marked point along a longer road. It measures distance travelled, not distance remaining.
Of Mimir's well — in the Norse telling, the spring of memory and wisdom that had to be paid for. In this house, the vault of an excavated life.
The least value a thing may take. A floor stated in advance.
That which perceives, holds and reasons. A mind is known by what it does, since nobody has seen one directly.
To dig through a mass for what is worth keeping. Mining moves far more than it takes.
That which digs through a mass to find what is worth keeping. A miner moves far more than it takes.
Smaller than the standard form. Of a thing reduced but not simplified.
Where names are coined — the striking of a new word into circulation; and the cool green herb wearing the same freshness.
Things placed under the wrong named class. A misclassification is a claim that turned out false about its subject.
To bring several together into one body. Also the balance struck between sounds — both are proportions chosen.
Make-directory's command name — the shell word that brings a folder into being.
The minutes-and-seconds clock face pattern — time's short dress for durations, as a format string speaks it.
Mnemosyne's — belonging to the Titaness of memory, mother of the Muses; this house's possessive for the remembrance realm's holdings.
Able to be carried and used in motion. Of a thing that meets a body wherever it is.
A stand-in used in place of the real thing while testing. A mock answers as expected and proves nothing about the real one.
A surface that takes the whole attention until it is answered. It stops everything behind it on purpose.
One way of operating among several available. A mode changes how a thing behaves without changing what it is.
A simplified stand-in used to reason about something too large to hold. Every model is wrong somewhere, and useful anyway.
The tending of what may be said or shown in a shared space. Moderation is a judgment exercised on behalf of others.
A part that changes the meaning of what it attaches to. A modifier has no standing of its own.
Built of self-contained parts that can be joined or replaced. Modularity buys change at the cost of seams.
To shape one signal by another — a voice through knobs, a wave riding a wave. The turning of a sound into its other selves without losing the throat it came from.
Varied in order to carry something. Modulation is how a steady signal is made to hold meaning.
Varying one thing to carry another. Modulation is how a steady signal is made to hold meaning.
A self-contained part that can be joined to others. A module knows its own edges.
The two-word compositions, spoken plural — the Grammar's own middle tier, atoms bonded into names.
A point in lived time small enough to hold — the unit a reaction pins to, the place a memory anchors.
Value made portable — the medium of exchange; in this house never the destination, and never the gate to dignity.
Watching a running thing so change is noticed as it happens. Monitoring reports; it does not intervene.
The colour of feeling a mind is presently in. A mood shapes everything met while it lasts, without being about any of it.
The night's companion light — cyclical, reflective, pulling tides; the sky's own emblem of phase and return.
Of the Morrígan — keeper of fate, war and sovereignty, in the Irish telling. A named power in this house's pantheon.
The one a body is born from — in this house, the repo whose copy births a sibling, features kept never stripped.
Change of position over time. Also a proposal put before a body for decision.
What moves a being to act. Motivation is a cause felt from the inside rather than observed.
To fix a thing in place so it can be used, and to bring it into a running system. Both make a thing present and held.
The hand-held pointer a screen is reached through. Named for its shape and tail.
To change position. Also to affect deeply — the same word for shifting a thing and for shifting a feeling.
Short form used in named media formats. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Millisecond — a thousandth of a second. The unit at which interface timing becomes felt.
Short form of message. Something sent from one to another to be received.
Many. A part placed at the front to make a thing plural.
Running across more than one line. Of a thing too long to be held in a single row.
More than one. The word that makes plurality explicit where singular was assumed.
A factor that scales another value. It changes magnitude without changing what is measured.
Holding at several sizes of view at once. Of a structure whose pattern survives zooming.
Sound ordered in time until it means something. The art that reaches a body before it reaches an argument.
To silence without removing. What is muted is still there and no longer heard.
Belonging to the one speaking. The word that claims a thing as one's own.

Mynd (Old Norse: a picture, an image, a likeness; and the shape a thing has, from munda, to aim at, to have in view). A living, animating drawing held still at one instant and handed over as a picture that stands on its own. A board is moving and somebody wants a picture of it, right now, exactly as it looks — not a re-render, not an approximation from the model, the actual thing. The browser already knows the answer: a paused animation's transform is a matrix in computed style and its opacity is a number there, so the hard part is done, by the engine, for free, and all that is needed is to read it and write it down. The world group is cloned, the live tree and the clone are walked side by side, each element's COMPUTED look and place are written inline on the clone, the class names the stylesheet gave meaning to are dropped, the reader's own pan and zoom are taken off, the definitions the marks point at travel inside the same text, and the result is serialized. THE ORIGINAL IS READ AND NEVER WRITTEN. Then pure string work: the frozen markup wrapped as a standalone document at one unit to one pixel, byte-stable so the same instant gives the same characters forever; a data URL; and a paint onto a canvas that hands back the picture's bytes. Every door to the drawing machine is INJECTED through a surface of two verbs, so the whole road runs where no browser stands and the proofs walk it there with a browser written by hand. The picture is DERIVED AND NEVER STORED — not the millisecond, not the size, not the pixels — and an empty board has no picture at all and says so, rather than answering with a blank rectangle. The pixel box rounds outward so no mark ever loses an edge to a rounding.
Belonging to what is known by direct experience rather than by argument. Of understanding that cannot be handed over in words.
The stories a people tell to hold what cannot be stated plainly. A mythology is true about meaning rather than about fact.
Events told in an order that makes them mean something. Narrative is not what happened; it is the shape given to what happened.
The voice a telling comes through. Every narrator stands somewhere, and where they stand is part of the story.
Of small extent across. Narrowness concentrates and excludes in the same motion.
Covering less than another. Narrowing concentrates and excludes in one motion.
The means of moving through a structure and knowing where you stand in it. Direction offered rather than imposed.
Knowing where you are and how to reach where you are going. Navigation is orientation before it is movement.
One who knows where they are and how to reach where they are going. Navigation is orientation before it is movement.
Short form of neurodivergent. Of a mind whose workings differ from what a society built for.
Closest of those available. Nearness is measured on a chosen axis, and naming it is the whole claim.

To bind, to tie, to weave together — the making of a connection, from which nexus and connect descend. Latin. Not the things joined and not the joining's result: the act of running the thread between them.
What must be had rather than what is wanted. A need is measured by what fails without it.
Less than nothing, or denying rather than affirming. Also the space around a shape, which does as much work as the shape.
The one who stands beside — closeness as relation; what things are to each other across a shared edge.
The sacred grove — the clearing set apart, a room made of trees rather than walls. Gaulish and Celtic. What makes it holy is that it is set aside and gathered in. This house's talking grove.
Named entity recognition — finding the names inside a text. Also a cut fragment as it appears here.
A cut fragment of partnership or ownership, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Contained within another of the same kind. Nesting is depth made of repetition.
A mesh that catches some things and lets others pass. Also short for network — both are things made of connections.
Things joined so that any can reach any other. A network's power is in its edges, not its nodes.
Of the nerves and the brain. A part placed at the front to make a thing about how a mind is wired.
A mapping of how a particular mind is wired and what it connects to what. A map of one nervous system rather than of minds in general.
A named colour in this house's palette, standing for connection and running theme. A named value rather than a general concept.
Not existing before now. Newness is a fact about time, and is constantly read as a claim about worth.
More recent than another. Newness is a fact about time and is constantly read as a claim about worth.
Most recently arrived — the youngest of the set, by honest timestamp.
The one following this. Next assumes an order and a place already occupied.
A point where many connections bind together. From the Latin for binding — a nexus is a knot rather than a place.
A compound fragment meaning a name index. Not an English word; flagged for the mis-cut band.
The machine handling of human language. A named field rather than a concept.
Refusal, or absence. The shortest complete sentence, and a full answer on its own.
Holding to what is right when nothing compels it. Nobility here is a description of conduct, not of rank.
A point where connections meet. A node's meaning comes from its edges rather than from itself.

Nomos (Greek νόμος: law, custom, that which is apportioned and held to — the law as a THING a house can point at). The policy document turned into columns: sections, subsections, the tables inside them and the date the document itself states, as DATA with no opinion about how any of it looks. DISTINCT FROM RENDERING, and the distinction is the whole reason it exists apart: a renderer takes structure and puts it on a screen, and this takes prose somebody wrote and finds the structure already in it. THE DATE IS THE DOCUMENT'S OR IT IS EMPTY — never a default, because a page printing a hardcoded date for a document that does not carry one is telling the reader something the document never said; both of the house's labels are read, "Last updated:" and "Effective date:". A TABLE IS LIFTED, NOT FLATTENED: a markdown table inside a section comes back as headers and rows on that section. NESTING IS KEPT and the tree is the document's own. NOTHING THROWS AND NOTHING IS INVENTED: an empty document, a document with no headings, a heading with no body, a subheading with no parent, a table outside any section, a header-less table and a ragged table all come back as calm shapes, and what the document does not say the parse does not say either. It parses a shape, not a language — lists, links, emphasis and code fences ride through as raw text, and only two heading levels nest. No clock, no disk, no network, no DOM, zero imports; reading the file stays the caller's business.
Not. A part placed at the front to deny what follows.
Outside version control — ground git does not watch; named so the unwatched is never mistaken for the recorded.
The arctic-blue theme family — cold light over quiet fjords, worn by editors; the name enters as itself.
To bring differing things into one common form. Normalisation makes comparison possible and loses what was particular.
The direction toward the pole. One of the four bearings, and the one maps are conventionally oriented to.
Of or toward the north. A bearing made into a description of a region.
The reversal of what follows. The word that turns an assertion into its denial.
A short record set down so it is not lost. Also a single sounded pitch.
A message sent to make someone aware of something now. It interrupts on purpose, which is why it must be worth it.
The present moment, which is the only one anything can be done in. Now is never a duration.
To destroy entirely rather than repair. A deliberate total removal, named for its bluntness.
Permitted to hold nothing. Nullability makes absence a valid state rather than an error.
A count or a measure, held as a value. A number carries no meaning until someone says what it counted.
A thing considered as a thing, apart from what it does. Also whatever an action is aimed at.
Attentive looking that records what is there. Observation is meant to change the observer and not the observed.
A place built for watching what is far away. An observatory changes nothing it studies.
